Pinnacle Niseko (Section) - Niseko Real Estate Videography
25 October 2024

Pinnacle Niseko in Hokkaido, Japan, presents a stunning location for real estate, and our expert photography captures its breathtaking landscapes. With panoramic views of Mount Yotei and vibrant seasonal colors, this land offers the perfect backdrop for creating a visual story that showcases the property's unique appeal. Our videography highlights every natural feature, helping potential buyers envision their dream sanctuary in one of Japan's most sought-after destinations.

Hikari House, Niseko Hirafu - Niseko Real Estate Photographer
21 October 2024

About Us:
Property Media Japan specialises in Real Estate Photography, Videography, Aerial Photography, Floor-plans and Virtual Staging. Previously based in Queenstown New Zealand, we are now operating in Niseko, Hokkaido Japan.

Discover modern sophistication in the heart of Niseko's prestigious Hirafu village with the newly built Hikari Townhouse. Completed in 2021, this property offers a perfect blend of luxury and comfort, designed for those seeking a stylish yet practical mountain retreat.
